_note: BMP280 barometric pressure + temperature sensor module (Bosch). I2C interface (default), SPI via CSB/SDO. 6-pin breakout: VCC, GND, SDA, SCL on bottom; CSB (chip select, active low, pull high for I2C), SDO (I2C address select: low=0x76, high=0x77) on top. Pressure 300-1100 hPa, temperature -40 to +85C. BME280 (adds humidity) is pin-compatible — same sidecar works.
